trending_policy: Trending items are exempt from the probation rule and are NOT sources: they are dated, sourced news items dropped after ~8 weeks or when superseded. A trending item never graduates into `sources` automatically — an entry must clear the normal bar on its own.

trending.text: Herdr joined Y Combinator (Fall 2026); runtime stays Apache-2.0. One-person team; YC page cites 25k stars and 340k downloads in four months.

v0.8.2: Windows support is now generally available on stable (previously preview-only); the plugin marketplace now discovers manifests at repository roots and subdirectories and groups multiple plugins per repository; Qwen Code state detection and native session restore.
Blog: 'Ten agents, three clients, 95% less CPU' — rendering and status-indicator work for running a fleet.
v0.7.5: installed and linked plugins are now global to the user rather than per session; plugins installed in a named session on 0.7.3 need reinstalling.
#1 on GitHub Trending; ~15k stars in early July, 33,189 on 2026-08-29. The plugin marketplace held 884 repositories on the same date, up from 684 twelve days earlier.
No company publicly documented as running Herdr in production could be found. Standing search target.
